purpose: Research additional recurring event families that could materially increase independent canonical_event_id N without modifying the already-used W4-BER-v1.0 dictionary.
admission_rule: A candidate family may enter a future expansion census only through a separately preregistered dictionary/protocol chosen from recurrence, prediction-venue coverage, official PIT event truth, economic asset mapping, historical depth, provenance and acquisition feasibility. Realized linked-asset returns, ARGOS PnL and post-hoc alpha are forbidden selection inputs.
